patterns.description: Customers frequently complain about the quality of the food.
Customers consistently find the pricing to be too high or not offering good value.
There are recurring issues with the staff's attitude or service.
The restaurant's atmosphere or physical environment receives negative feedback.
There are recurring negative comments about general aspects not covered by other categories.
Customers frequently experience long wait times.

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently complain about the quality of the food.
root_causes.cause: Inconsistent food preparation, low-quality ingredients, or issues with recipe execution.

root_causes.pattern: Customers consistently find the pricing to be too high or not offering good value.
root_causes.cause: Perceived high prices relative to food quality/portion size or local market, or lack of clear value proposition.

root_causes.pattern: There are recurring issues with the staff's attitude or service.
root_causes.cause: Lack of proper staff training, insufficient staffing leading to stress, or poor management oversight.

root_causes.pattern: The restaurant's atmosphere or physical environment receives negative feedback.
root_causes.cause: Outdated decor, poor lighting, uncomfortable seating, or excessive noise levels.

root_causes.pattern: There are recurring negative comments about general aspects not covered by other categories.
root_causes.cause: General operational inefficiencies, lack of attention to detail, or specific recurring minor issues (e.g., specific menu items, availability).

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently experience long wait times.
root_causes.cause: Understaffing during peak hours, inefficient order processing, or kitchen delays.
